name: agentedit-guard
description: Enforces AgentEdit provenance records for Codex edits to LaTeX and BibTeX sources.

interface.shortDescription: Require reviewable provenance for LaTeX edits.
interface.longDescription: Blocks Codex write tools when a protected TeX or BibTeX change does not retain the original source, edited source, stable identifier, and reason.
interface.defaultPrompt: Bootstrap AgentLaTeX or apply its provenance policy to every LaTeX and BibTeX change.
